scalar_scope: atomic AUROC; bare AND AUROC and OR TF/FT-vs-FF AUROC; two OR wordings on the OR boundary; paired mean metrics, contrasts, cross-model paired contrast and retention decisions
wording_scope: OR TF/FT-vs-FF paired wording comparisons at pooled/macro scopes for all scalar heads; includes the unchanged OR support in the AND-wording condition
constituent_scope: explicit FIRST/SECOND AB/BA targets, confusion/accuracy, Boolean/min-max ranking, point and classification checks at all/AB/BA orders; bootstrap intervals for all-order pooled/macro records and target-vs-source transfer contrasts
limitation: Not every field or every individual-topic endpoint has a second implementation. Complete frozen replay separately checks every report row and all 85 frozen-head prediction archives.
coverage_basis: Read pinned verify_report selection predicates and count existing report records; no metric recalculation or new scientific analysis
